text:
Google's map runs a simple framework. Three questions about your business.

Do you do what they typed?
Are you close to them?
Do people know you and rate you?

You can't move your shop closer. The other two you can work on every week.

Pool builder in Baldivis asks me: "Why don't I show up when someone in Joondalup searches 'pool builder'?"

Joondalup is on the other side of Perth.

Google's map favours businesses close to the person searching.

Win the searches in your own area first.

Meta needs about 50 results a week from an ad set before it learns who to show your ad to.

Small budget split across five ad sets? Each one gets ten.

None of them ever finish learning.

Run one ad set with one offer. Let it collect the 50.
